digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge command group and dispatch
propositions: Establish functional `bridge preview` (read-only, no Jira/ticket-store mutation) and `bridge sync` (mutating) as the first verbs under a new nested `bridge` noun with subcommand dispatch.
Preserve all legacy top-level commands (`reconcile`, `jira-onboard`, `bridge-probe`, `bridge-fsck`, `rebar doctor`) and in-repo consumers without breaking changes at this story boundary.

Prevent placeholder or unimplemented verbs from being advertised; only ship `bridge preview` and `bridge sync` in this story; defer `setup`, `check-access`, `fsck`, `status`, `pause`, `resume` to downstream stories.
Ensure `Mode`, `MODE_CAPS`, and the `gated_mode: reconcile-check` round trip remain intact and survive the refactoring.
Forbid callers from passing `--mode` or `--filter-local-ids` through the bridge foundation to override the read/write distinction between preview and sync.
Verify that `bridge doctor` remains unknown (health check is `bridge fsck`), `rebar doctor` remains functional, and nested verb names never fall through to top-level commands.
